The actual verify_chvatal.py additionally tests legal 49/13-step elementary collapse sequences for D_0 and L_2 and exhaustive 4+8 graph-automorphism orbit transfer; edge-preserving generators and independent-set deletion counts distinguish the two orbits. Forman matching implies S2, point, S2, S1, point, respectively; link-cone gluing makes D_v→K a homotopy equivalence in the B orbit. The chromatic backtracking in the actual package verifies chi(G)=4 and chi(G-v)=3 for all v. Exact finite graph, not infinite family.

value.rationale: The Chvátal graph is a canonical 4-chromatic vertex-critical triangle-free graph. A full, exact two-orbit classification of its independence-complex deletion/link behavior is a motivated natural graph-complex invariant: all 12 graph vertex deletions reduce chromatic number, while only four eliminate the independence-complex S2 homotopy. Complete 12-vertex finite classification is a substantive topological/chromatic contrast independent of the previously known global S2 claim.

limitations: Finite single-graph result; topological conclusion depends on valid full-face Morse orientations and standard Forman and cone-gluing theorems.
